summary: Iteration-15 pre-sale hardening + mobile sweep verification. Backend pytest 10/10 PASS (~2.6s) covering: companion script_version field on /poll, SCRIPT_VERSION constant baked into /public-script, GET/PUT/DELETE /api/avatar/api-key (BYO D-ID key) + masked_key format, DELETE /api/auth/me confirm=DELETE guard + cascade delete across 20 collections + deletion_log entry + session-token invalidation + second-user isolation, plus regression on /auth/me and /companion/easy-installer. Frontend: 4 legal pages (/privacy /terms /refunds /support) load with correct unique <title>s ('Privacy Policy — Heirloom' etc.), '← back to Heirloom' link, mailto: link, zero console errors. SiteFooter renders on authenticated pages with all 4 legal links + mailto. Settings page renders both [data-testid=settings-d-id-section] and [data-testid=settings-danger-zone] + Delete button. Delete-account prompt: Cancel = no-op (200), wrong text = no-op (200), typing 'DELETE' = account deleted + session 401 + redirect to home. Mobile (390x844): sidebar hidden, hamburger visible, drawer opens on click, scrim tap closes (DOM removed), ESC closes, nav-link tap closes + route changes. Desktop (1920x1080) regression: sidebar visible, hamburger hidden. Mobile pages /, /login, /buy, /twin, /dashboard all 0px horizontal overflow.
action_items: Nothing required. Pre-sale hardening + mobile sweep ships GREEN.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py DELETE /me cascade is comprehensive — wipes all 20 listed collections, logs a deletion_log row with per-collection counts for fraud/tax records, and clears the session_token cookie. `import time` is present at the top of auth.py (line 1), so the `int(time.time())` call in the deletion_log event_id works correctly. GDPR/CCPA compliant.
avatar.py masked_key uses U+2026 (…) between first-6 and last-4 chars. Frontend display matches.

companion.py: COMPANION_SCRIPT_VERSION='2026.02.27.1' is defined AFTER the /poll handler in source order, but Python resolves it lazily at call time so it works. Minor stylistic suggestion: move the constant above the handler that references it for readability — not a bug.

AppLayout.jsx mobile drawer: useEffect closes drawer on route change (location.pathname); useEffect on Escape key cleans up listener; scrim onClick + nav-link onClick both call setDrawerOpen(false). All 4 close paths verified working.

Translate-transform-based drawer (-translate-x-full off-canvas) is correctly hidden via bounding-box even though Playwright's is_visible() reports true — note for future test agents: use bounding_box().x check, not is_visible(), to assert drawer state.

Legal pages (Privacy/Terms/Refunds/Support) each set document.title via useEffect — verified all 4 unique titles. No SSR (CRA app), so titles are set client-side after mount; SEO/social-share scrapers that don't run JS will see 'Heirloom' as title. Not a launch blocker but worth knowing.
SiteFooter rendered globally inside main scroll area — appears on every authenticated route. All 4 legal links + mailto:support@heirloom.app present.
PostHog reference confirmed removed from /app/frontend/public/index.html (no posthog or emergent tracker script tags).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 15 is GREEN. The mobile drawer is in DOM at all times (transformed off-canvas when closed); use bounding_box().x or transform style — NOT is_visible() — to assert open/closed state in Playwright. Backend has 10 net-new tests in test_iteration15_prelaunch.py covering account-deletion cascade, D-ID BYO key, and companion script_version — keep as regression. Iteration 14's 52 tests (test_iteration14_prelaunch_regression.py) still apply.
rca_of_the_issue: No real bugs. Initial mobile-drawer test produced 3 false-negative 'drawer stayed visible' reports because Playwright is_visible() returns true for elements that are translated off-screen via CSS transform. Re-tested with bounding_box().x check — all 4 close paths (scrim tap, ESC, nav-link tap, x-button) confirmed working. Test methodology corrected; no code change required.
